next.reason: 1985: "FUNCTION NUMVAL-C ( argument-1 [ argument-2 ] )"; 2023: "FUNCTION NUMVAL-C ( argument-1 ┌ LOCALE [ locale-name-1 ] ┐ │ │ [ ANYCASE ] ) └ argument-2 ┘". 2023 keeps optional argument-2 but adds a LOCALE [locale-name-1] alternative to it and an optional ANYCASE phrase, so it accepts forms the 1985 format refuses.
